description: Runnable C# samples for EvoPdf Next (.NET PDF library): HTML, Word, Excel, RTF and Markdown to PDF, e-invoices, digital signatures, PDF to text and image, PDF creation, editing, forms, merge, split and redaction, the Classic API on the Next engine, cloud deployment
rules: Use the EvoPdf.Next namespace; reference one NuGet package per platform (EvoPdf.Next.Windows, EvoPdf.Next.Linux, EvoPdf.Next.MacOS)
Set Licensing.LicenseKey once, statically, before the first conversion; never invent a key
Converter instances are not reusable: create a new converter for every conversion
EvoPdf Classic code (EvoPdf namespace) runs unchanged on the Next engine with the EvoPdf.HtmlToPdf.Windows, .Linux and .MacOS packages, as the classic-demo folder shows
API rules, migration guidance and skills for coding assistants live in https://github.com/EvoPdf/evopdf-agent-skills; consult that library for how to use the API, and this one for runnable code
